rv.q: You could certainly do worse than this show. You could also certainly do better.
Yet there’s a lot of filler, not enough killer.
Curtains is a show not to be missed either in London or around the UK on its tour.
Curtains has arrived not a moment too soon: cheers, not sneers, all round.
With a superb cast led by comedian Jason Manford, the new production at the Wyndham's is filled with charm and wit that makes its arrival well worth waiting for.
Visually, the piece is a real treat – colourful, exciting and above all, surprising.
The trouble is, it really isn't. The plot is ridiculously convoluted and there isn't one decent song.

cn.t: This musical whodunnit earns mixed reviews: one critic praises its infectious fun and exquisite cast, while others find it merely adequate—entertaining enough but far from essential theater.
